name: @vineethnkrishnan/intercom-mcp

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: Lists recent conversations from Intercom with state, assignee, and last message preview. Use to browse conversation volume or find conversations by recency.

limit.description: Number of conversations to return (default 20, max 150).

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Retrieves full conversation details including all conversation parts (messages, notes, assignments), participants, tags, and custom attributes. Returns a flattened chronological timeline.

tools.name: search_conversations
tools.description: Searches conversations using Intercom's search endpoint. Searches by message body content. Use this to find conversations about a specific topic, issue, or keyword.

query.description: Search query to match against conversation message bodies.

tools.name: reply_to_conversation
tools.description: Sends an admin reply to an Intercom conversation. The reply is visible to the customer. Use this to respond to a customer's message.

conversation_id.description: The Intercom conversation ID to reply to.

body.description: The HTML or plain-text body of the reply.

admin_id.description: The ID of the admin sending the reply.

tools.name: close_conversation
tools.description: Closes an Intercom conversation on behalf of an admin. The conversation will be marked as closed and removed from the open queue.

conversation_id.description: The Intercom conversation ID to close.

admin_id.description: The ID of the admin closing the conversation.

tools.name: snooze_conversation
tools.description: Snoozes an Intercom conversation until a specified time. The conversation will reopen automatically when the snooze period expires.

conversation_id.description: The Intercom conversation ID to snooze.

admin_id.description: The ID of the admin snoozing the conversation.

snoozed_until.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the conversation should reopen.

tools.name: assign_conversation
tools.description: Assigns an Intercom conversation to a specific admin or team. Use this to route conversations to the appropriate handler.

conversation_id.description: The Intercom conversation ID to assign.

admin_id.description: The ID of the admin performing the assignment (the actor).

assignee_id.description: The ID of the admin or team to assign the conversation to.

tools.name: add_note
tools.description: Adds an internal note to an Intercom conversation. Notes are only visible to admins and are not sent to the customer.

conversation_id.description: The Intercom conversation ID to add a note to.

admin_id.description: The ID of the admin adding the note.

body.description: The HTML or plain-text body of the note.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: Lists contacts (users and leads) from Intercom with email, name, role, and last seen time. Use to browse contacts or find recently active users.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Retrieves full details for a specific contact including email, name, custom attributes, tags, companies, and location data.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Searches contacts by email using Intercom's search endpoint. Use this to find a specific user or lead by their email address.

query.description: Email address or partial email to search for.
